_help: Per-org values (Release Relay pipeline files version 13). Branches hold {{relay:NAME}} placeholders; validate, deploy and sync (back promote) fill them with the target environment's value in a temporary copy of the deployment (never committed), and fail when a placeholder has no value for that environment. Raises that write org metadata into a branch (modes org and hub) turn the source environment's values (6 characters or longer) back into placeholders. NAME: A-Z, 0-9 and _ (up to 60). Inner keys: the Git environment names the pipeline uses (environment / target_environment). Keys starting with _ are ignored. Example: "values": { "PAYMENT_URL": { "dev1": "https://dev.pay.example", "sit": "https://sit.pay.example", "prod": "https://pay.example" } }. Read from the pipeline's own commit (the default branch), never from a release branch.
